name: dominusnode_fetch
description: Fetch a public web page through the DominusNode relay network (real residential, datacenter or mobile exit IPs contributed by node operators). GET or HEAD only; ports 80/443; private, local and DNS-rebinding targets are refused; redirects are returned, not followed; body capped at 10 MB. https:// is the default; http:// needs allow_http (plaintext is visible to the exit node). Billed per GB from the prepaid wallet at the rates in network_pricing.

url.description: Absolute https:// (or http:// with allow_http) URL of a public page.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 exit country, e.g. US, DE, JP. Sanctioned countries (CU, IR, KP, RU, SY) are refused. Use network_stats to see which countries have online nodes.

ip_class.description: Optional exit IP class. Prices differ per class: read network_pricing. Omit to let the relay choose.

session_id.description: Optional sticky-session id (1-64 letters/digits): reuse it to keep the same exit IP across requests.

allow_http.description: Opt in to plaintext http:// targets. The exit node can see and modify plaintext traffic, so only use it for public, non-sensitive pages. https:// is always end-to-end encrypted through the relay.

name: dominusnode_proxy_url
description: Build a proxy URL for HTTP clients (curl, browsers, scrapers) that route through the relay. Routing flags go in the username (country-XX, class-..., session-..., allowhttp-1). The API key is NOT included: the result contains the placeholder ${DOMINUSNODE_API_KEY}, which the caller substitutes from its own environment.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 exit country, e.g. US, DE, JP. Sanctioned countries (CU, IR, KP, RU, SY) are refused. Use network_stats to see which countries have online nodes.

ip_class.description: Optional exit IP class. Prices differ per class: read network_pricing. Omit to let the relay choose.

session_id.description: Optional sticky-session id (1-64 letters/digits): reuse it to keep the same exit IP across requests.

allow_http.description: Opt in to plaintext http:// targets. The exit node can see and modify plaintext traffic, so only use it for public, non-sensitive pages. https:// is always end-to-end encrypted through the relay.

protocol.description: http (default; CONNECT for https) or socks5.

name: dominusnode_network_policy
description: Read the relay network's current acceptable-use policy (version, sha256, body) and the fixed floor guarantees every node enforces (ports, blocked targets, no payload logging). Public; no account needed.

name: dominusnode_network_pricing
description: Live per-GB prices for each exit IP class (in µUSD per GB; 1 USD = 1,000,000 µUSD), the node operators' revenue share per tier, the earnings maturation period and accepted payment rails. Always use this instead of assuming prices.

name: dominusnode_network_stats
description: Count of online relay nodes by IP class and by country. Use it to pick a country/class that has capacity.

name: dominusnode_balance
description: Prepaid wallet balance (cents and USD) that pays for relay traffic.

name: dominusnode_transactions
description: Recent prepaid wallet transactions (top-ups, usage charges, credit conversions).

name: dominusnode_topup_crypto
description: Create a crypto invoice to top up the prepaid wallet. Returns an invoice id and a payment URL for a human or wallet to pay; nothing is charged by this call. Amount 1000-100000 cents ($10-$1,000). Track it with check_payment.

name: dominusnode_check_payment
description: Status of a crypto top-up invoice created by topup_crypto (waiting, confirming, finished, ...).

name: dominusnode_usage
description: Bandwidth usage and cost summary with recent records for a date range (defaults to the server's window).

name: dominusnode_active_sessions
description: Currently open relay sessions (id, start time, status).

name: dominusnode_report_session
description: Report a relay session whose exit node misbehaved (blocked, captcha, rate_limited, slow, bad_content, other). Reports feed node reputation; there is a daily limit.

name: dominusnode_node_list
description: List the relay nodes you contribute (status, observed IP, country, class, caps, reputation, last seen). To add one, see node_setup_guide.

name: dominusnode_node_tier
description: Your node-operator tier, the next tier and progress toward it (tier sets your revenue share and withdraw limit).

name: dominusnode_node_setup_guide
description: Step-by-step instructions to earn credit by contributing an IP with the DominusNode node agent: how earning and tiers work, registering a node (signed locally with your wallet key) and running the agent.

name: dominusnode_credits_balance
description: Node-operator earnings: pending, available and frozen credit (µUSD), tier, withdraw limits and payout status.

name: dominusnode_credits_convert
description: Convert available node credit into prepaid wallet balance to pay for your own relay traffic. Amount in µUSD (10,000 = $0.01 up to 10,000,000,000). Pass the same idempotency_key to retry safely.

amount_musd.description: Amount in µUSD as a whole-number string, e.g. "5000000" for $5.

name: dominusnode_payouts_list
description: On-chain payout history for node earnings (amount, status, tx hash). Withdrawals themselves need a wallet signature and are not available here.

name: dominusnode_x402_info
description: x402 (HTTP 402 micropayment) support: facilitators, networks, currencies and per-request pricing.
